description: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for two models, MMAR and MMAU, across several audio and music reasoning tasks. The horizontal axis displays the task names: “Instruct,” “Audio-Reasoner,” and “Qwen-2.5-Omni,” listed in that order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Two bars are present for each task, representing the accuracy of each model; the blue bars represent MMAU and the lighter blue bars represent MMAR. For the “Instruct” task, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 52% accuracy, while the MMAR bar reaches approximately 40%. For “Audio-Reasoner”, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 62% accuracy, and the MMAR bar reaches approximately 58%. Finally, for “Qwen-2.5-Omni”, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 68% accuracy, and the MMAR bar reaches approximately 65%. The bars are not visually emphasized and are arranged in groups corresponding to each task, with MMAU consistently positioned to the left of MMAR within each group.
